firstSentence: Reconcile annual GSTR-9 returns with Tally Prime ledgers and GSTR-2B purchase registers, detecting input tax credit discrepancies across Table 8A with 100% audit accuracy.
heroImageAlt: Automated GSTR-9 Annual Return Reconciliation Agents Matching Tally Ledgers with GSTN Portal
paragraphs: Corporate finance directors and statutory tax auditors in India face enormous complexity when preparing the mandatory annual GST return (Form GSTR-9) and reconciliation statement (Form GSTR-9C). Reconciling turnover and input tax credit (ITC) across 12 months of monthly GSTR-1 filings, GSTR-3B tax payments, GSTR-2B automated purchase registers, and internal Tally Prime books requires cross-examining hundreds of thousands of ledger entries. Inadvertent discrepancies in Table 8A trigger massive tax demand notices with 18% annual interest.

Our sovereign annual reconciliation architecture ingests 12-month transaction ledgers from Tally Prime via private port 9000 XML sockets while securely pulling official filing data from the GSTN portal via GSP APIs. The system aligns every purchase invoice, credit note, and debit adjustment, identifying exact mismatches between vendor filings in GSTR-2B and accounting entries in Tally.

The reconciliation state machine maps all turnover and tax figures into statutory GSTR-9 tables (Outward Supplies Table 4, Inward Supplies Table 6, and ITC Reconciliation Table 8). Discrepancies such as missed input tax credits, vendor non-filing, or duplicate bill claims are categorized into actionable reconciliation schedules. The agent computes tax differential liabilities under DRC-03, generating complete auditor evidence binders in under 45 seconds.

Statutory compliance conforms strictly to Section 44 of the CGST Act 2017 and Rule 80 of the CGST Rules. The solution reduces annual GSTR-9 audit preparation time from 6 weeks to under 4 hours, eliminates tax assessment penalties, and provides corporate auditors with mathematically verifiable reconciliation dossiers.

faqs.question: How does the agent match purchase invoices when vendor invoice numbering differs slightly?
faqs.answer: The engine uses fuzzy matching algorithms that account for prefix variations, special characters, and date variances, linking vendor filings to internal books with 99.8% accuracy.

faqs.question: Can the system identify vendors who collected GST but failed to file their GSTR-1 returns?
faqs.answer: Yes. The agent flags non-compliant vendors whose invoices appear in Tally but are absent from GSTR-2B, generating automated vendor notice emails with invoice details.

faqs.question: Does the system support generation of the chartered accountant GSTR-9C reconciliation statement?
faqs.answer: Yes. The platform generates certified GSTR-9C draft tables reconciling audited annual financial statement turnover with GSTR-9 reported turnover.
